items.title: GE Vernova (GEV) Signs Up 43 India Wind Turbines Under Make In India
items.summary: GE Vernova (NYSE:GEV) agreed to supply 43 onshore wind turbines for Enfinity Global’s Fatehgarh Wind Farm project in India. The turbines are planned to be manufactured under GE Vernova’s Make in India approach, using its established facilities in the country. The order highlights GE Vernova’s role in large scale renewable projects in one of the world’s major wind power markets.
